what: A walks to a spot in (1,0), waits for the position keeper, reads where it stands and the head, then quits from Play (Browser.close)

actions.eval: (async () => { const P = await import('/engine/playerProbe.ts'); const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const H = await import('/history/index.ts'); const p = P.samplePlayer(); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ pos: p && { sceneId: p.sceneId, x: +p.x.toFixed(3), z: +p.z.toFixed(3), yaw: +p.yaw.toFixed(3) }, chunk: S.useEngineStore.getState().chunk, head: H.worldNow().head, link: w.status.link, pending: w.status.pending, player: localStorage.getItem('aether.playerName') ?? localStorage.getItem('unwritten.playerName') }) })()
